title: Enforce persistent-banner and post-match interstitial eligibility
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement adEligibility exactly as frozen in section B096 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Web is an honest no-op. Native free build always reserves its banner dock regardless of consent/load; banner request requires consent. Interstitial requires consent, availability, explicit completed-match exit after reading Match End, no live phase/modal, completedMatches>=2 and at least two completed matches since the last shown interstitial (null treated as zero). Remove Ads disables all formats/dock. This never waits for an ad or invokes a native SDK.
acceptance: Native free surfaces reserve dock through missing consent/load, while web/RemoveAds use no dock or ad requests.
First-match, live-phase, unread result, blocked modal and unavailable-ad cases never permit interstitial or navigation blocking.
At match2 with no previous interstitial and match4 after match2 eligibility opens; malformed/unsafe counters or future last-show counts reject.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
